$schema-note: Cross-boundary design tokens: the palette values that are restated OUTSIDE
frontend/src/app.css, in files that cannot read a CSS custom property — a
favicon SVG, the pre-CSS offline page, the SSR <style> block Python emits,
app.css remains the design surface and defines the full palette. Only the
handful of values that must be duplicated live here, so there is one place
to change them and one place to check them against.
After editing this file run:  python3 tools/design/sync_tokens.py --write
backend/tests/test_design_tokens.py fails the suite if anything drifts.

accent.role: Brand mark and interaction. The one blue the logo is drawn in.

primary.role: Link ink — accent darkened to clear WCAG AA on --surface.

subtle.role: Tertiary marks: breadcrumb separators, hairline glyphs.

theme-color.role: Browser/OS chrome tint. Light tints to brand; dark matches --app-bar.
